args.query: pre-existing disease waiting period corporate group plan

final_answer: The pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period for a corporate group plan is 12 months of continuous cover, as stated in section 03_Waiting_Periods_Group_Plans.md#pre-existing-disease-waiting-period of the policy document. This means that a PED claim is payable after 12 months of continuous cover, with the months counted from the first policy start date with Saffron Shield in completed months.
